content: 'Apɨrahami mana mɨyetɨa kaneyani Nekexi mɨrakutewatsie 'erietɨ, Karetsi Tsuhuxi wahixɨapa kaniuyuhayewa Keraxi mɨrakutewatsie.
'Apɨrahami, Tsara mɨ'ɨyayatɨkai, kename 'iwayatɨkai kaniutainekaitɨni. 'Ayumieme mana 'Awimereki, Keraxi kwieyaritsie ti'aitame, katiniuta'aita mɨwitɨkiemiekɨ Tsara, neiwitɨni 'ɨyaya mayanikɨ.
Hikɨ mɨkɨ tɨkaritsie, Kakaɨyari 'Awimereki kaniutahɨawe heinɨtsitana, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Neuxei 'ekɨ pekanimɨmɨkɨ 'ukaratsi pemewitɨkɨ, mɨkɨ 'ukaratsi kaniwikieka.
Hikɨ 'Awimereki 'ukaratsi hamatɨa mɨkakahuiwekaikɨ, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Ti'aitame, pepɨkanetsikumemiwani, ne 'axanepɨkatiuyuri,
'Apɨrahami mɨpaɨ pɨnerahɨawekai kename 'iwayatɨkai, 'ukaratsi yaxeikɨata pɨnetiutahɨawixɨ, neri yurikɨ neti'erietɨ nepeiwitɨ, peru ne'ɨyaya ne'inawairienike nepɨkatiuyuri.
Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Mɨpaɨ nepɨtimate, yuri petiwa'eririetɨ pepeiwitɨ, 'ayumieme nepɨkamatsi'upitɨa pemikumayɨanikɨ, xurikime pemɨkatiwiwiwanikɨ nehetsɨa.

Peru mɨkɨ 'ukaratsi keneyetua hikɨ, mɨkɨ kɨnaya niukame kanihɨkɨtɨni nehetsiemieme, kanenitawawiriemɨkɨ 'ahetsiemieme pemuyeikanikɨ 'akuxi, peru xɨka peka'iyetuani 'ekɨ yaxeikɨa 'akie kiekatari wahamatɨa pekanimɨmɨkɨ.
'Uxa'arieka ximeri 'Awimereki yuteɨterima warutahɨaweka, katiniwarutaxatɨani kemɨtiuheinɨkai. Mɨkɨ me'i'enieka waɨkawa mekaniutimamani.

Hikɨ 'Awimereki, 'Apɨrahami katiniutanɨ'airieni mɨpaɨ katinitatieni: —Neuxei, kepetatsi'uyuri. ¿Kepaukakuta 'axanepɨmatsi'uyuri, titayari xurikime petatitiwiwiriwa nehetsie meta nemɨra'aita wahetsie? 'Axamemɨte'u'iyari kememɨkanetsi'uyuri 'ekɨ pɨta waɨkawa 'axapepɨnetsi'uyuri.
hikɨ 'Apɨrahami mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Ne mɨpaɨ nepɨtiku'eriwakai, xeme Kakaɨyari xeka'ayemakaxeme nepɨ'eriekai, xenetsimienike nepɨ'eriekai ne'ɨya hetsiemieme.
Peru kaniyuritɨni mɨkɨ kanine'iwatɨni, nepaapa niweya kanihɨkɨtɨni, peru nemaama pɨkaniweya, 'ayumieme pɨyɨwekai ne'ɨya mayanikɨ.

Kepauka mɨpaɨ mɨnetiuta'aitɨa Kakaɨyari, kename nepaapa nemaama newaku'eirienikekai, kename 'ateewa neyemiekai, ne ne'ɨya mɨpaɨ nepɨtiutahɨawixɨ: «Neuxei mɨpaɨ nepɨmatiwawirie: Tsepa hakewa temekɨ, kename ne 'amatsika nehɨkɨ peputaineni».
Hikɨ 'Awimereki Tsara 'Apɨrahami kaniyetuirieni meta katinimini muxatsi, wakaitsixi, te'uximayatamete 'ukitsi meta 'ukarawetsixi.
Meta 'Awimereki mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Neuxei, nekwie 'ena kanikumaka, hakewa mɨmatsihenakeni mana keneukani.

Tsara meta mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Neuxei, 'a'iwa nepu'ɨitɨa tamamata heimana xewi kiruyari heimana 'imeriyu pɨrata tepɨayari, mɨkɨ kani'ayumiemetɨni 'axapemɨkaramamatiwanikɨ, mɨpaɨ memɨtehetimanikɨ 'a'iwama kename 'ekɨ 'atsipekatiuyuri, mɨpaɨ xewitɨ 'atsipɨkametitamani.
Hikɨ 'Apɨrahami Kakaɨyari kaniutawawirieni, kepauka muyutanenewi Kakaɨyari 'aixɨa kaniwaruyurieni 'Awimereki meta 'ɨyaya, metatsiere mɨtiwa'aitɨakai, memɨniwewawenikɨ hutarieka,
Tsara mɨya mɨranuyetɨakɨ, 'Apɨrahami 'ɨyaya, Yawé 'Awimereki kie kiekatari 'ukarawetsixi mekaniwewaweme kaniwarayeitɨakaitɨni.
